gbifID.description: Unique GBIF occurrence identifier for each moth observation record.

datasetKey.description: Unique GBIF dataset identifier linking all records to the same occurrence dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URL linking to iNaturalist record for each moth sighting.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for all records is Animalia.

phylum.description: Arthropoda taxonomic division for all occurrence records.

class.description: Taxonomic class of each record, uniformly Insecta.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently Lepidoptera.

family.description: Family classification of the moth, consistently Geometridae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded moth species, consistently Lychnosea.

species.description: Scientific name of the observed moth, constant across all records.

infraspecificEpithet.description: No infraspecific epithet recorded for any occurrence.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, consistently classified at species level.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the observed moth species, including author citation.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the moth species recorded in each occurrence.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Original scientific name authorship as recorded in the source occurrence data.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO code identifying the nation where each observation was recorded.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: US state where each moth observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: Observation status is consistently recorded as present for all records.

individualCount.description: Number of individuals observed in each occurrence record.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude of each observation expressed in decimal degrees.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees indicating westward position of observations.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: No coordinate precision data recorded for observations.

elevation.description: Elevation of observation site, measured in meters above sea level.

elevationAccuracy.description: No elevation accuracy values recorded for any observation.

depth.description: Depth data unavailable for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy data is unavailable for these records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

year.description: Observation year of each record, ranging from 2006 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Constant taxonomic identifier for Lychnosea intermicata across all records.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxon identifier for Lychnosea intermicata observations.

basisOfRecord.description: Human observation records denote that each occurrence was reported by a person.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier, consistently iNaturalist for all records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique specimen identifier assigned by GBIF for each Lychnosea intermicata occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: Record number field, absent values across all rows.

identifiedBy.description: Name of person who recorded the species observation.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time the observation record was identified, ranging from 2014 to 2026.

license.description: License under which each occurrence record is released, using standard Creative Commons identifiers.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder names of individuals or organizations providing the occurrence data.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each moth observation.

typeStatus.description: typeStatus is absent for all records, offering no type designation data.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means field is entirely missing in this dataset.

lastInterpreted.description: Date and time when the record was last interpreted, recorded to microsecond precision.

mediaType.description: Media type of observation, typically a still image.

issue.description: Issue flags data quality problems such as rounded coordinates, derived continent, or missing taxon ID.

lychnosea_intermicata.description: GBIF occurrence records of Lychnosea intermicata moth observations across US states with timestamps and coordinates.
